title: Events and delegations in practice
intro: Protect information at conferences and official visits. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: Gift flash drive from the delegation
decisions.prompt: The delegation gave you their presentation on a flash drive. What do you do with this file?
decisions.explain: Technical support checks the device on a separate computer and passes the file on if needed.

decisions.title: Forum Wi-Fi sign-in page
decisions.prompt: You joined the open network ReqemYol-Forum-FREE and this page opened. What do you do?

artifact.title: RəqəmYol Forum Wi-Fi
body: Welcome to RəqəmYol Forum. Sign in with your work account to get online.

decisions.explain: A Wi-Fi page never needs your work password. Leave the network and ask the registration desk for the right one.

decisions.title: Drive already plugged in
decisions.prompt: Someone plugged the delegation's drive into your computer and it shows this file. What do you do?
decisions.explain: Eject the device without opening the file and give it to technical support.

decisions.title: Message from ReqemYol
decisions.prompt: Things that arrive during the event. Safe, or a threat?

artifact.name: ReqemYol
body: Your badge is ready. Bring your ID card to the registration desk.

decisions.explain: No link, nothing to pay and nothing to type. This is a normal reminder.

decisions.title: Your attendance certificate
decisions.prompt: Things that arrive during the event. Safe, or a threat?

artifact.subject: Your attendance certificate
body: Sign in with your work email to download the certificate:

decisions.explain: The official site is reqemyol-forum.example, and this is a different domain. A certificate never needs your work password.
